'''Maslovar Tiatiov''' served as the military leader of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Desevro/Legends|Desevro]].

==Biography==
When the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] became the [[King/Legends|king]] of the [[Kingdom of Cron]], he lead an attack on the worlds of the [[Livien League]], including Desevro. After completely [[Battle of Jhantoria|defeating]] the League on [[Jhantoria]], he planned to raze Desevro to the ground, but was persuaded not to by Tiatiov. The Desevrar leader took Xim on a tour of the planet's fighting academies and showed Xim the efficiency of the planet's bureaucracy, persuading the king to spare the planet.
